★★★★☆

Used Kilbarrack Van Co for a move from Phibsborough to Drumcondra in October. It was a two-bed flat, mostly my own stuff, and the new place is a fourth-floor walk-up with no lift, so not the handiest of jobs.

I booked through the website and paid a €50 deposit by Revolut. The quote was €340 for two lads and the van for up to four hours, which was the best value I found – the other quotes I got were €450 and up. The move itself took about three and a half hours.

They were meant to arrive at 9 but got there at half 10. To be fair, Dessie texted at 8.40 to say the previous job had overrun, and he knocked €40 off afterwards without me asking. It wasn’t the end of the world for me, but worth bearing in mind if you’ve a tight handover with a landlord or need to be out by a certain time.

Once they got going, the two lads worked hard and were sound about the four flights of stairs. The couch wouldn’t go around the turn on the third floor, but one of them took the legs off with an Allen key he had in his pocket and it went straight in. They also put my bed back together without being asked and took away a flat-pack shelf I didn’t want, which I really appreciated.

The one other thing was that the brass base of a floor lamp got chipped. It was my nanny’s lamp so I was a bit gutted. They’d wrapped everything else in blankets, but not that, so I’d say just make sure any smaller or awkward bits are wrapped too. Wrap the lamps, lads!

Overall I’d use them again. Good value, hardworking and helpful, with a couple of things that could have gone better. Four stars feels fair.
